title: Trendy East Nashville Loft -Walkable, Bright, Cozy
description:
Charming 2 bedroom (3 beds), one bath Loft  just 10 min to downtown, 15 min to airport & 8 min Opryland. Nestled in a quiet/safe neighborhood in East Nashville, yet walkable to some favorite bars/food & just 6 blocks to Kroger. Natural light, desk/chair for remote workers, comfy beds & plenty of pillows for a cozy stay!  

*This is Upstairs level of our home, totally private w separate entrance, separate driveway & separate central heat/air. 
*KITCHENETTE only - microwave, coffee, fridge

The space
Amenities - AT&T Fiber Wifi,  Smart TV w Hulu/Amazon/Netflix, microwave, mini fridge, and Kuerig Coffee station. No worries if you forget your toiletries - shampoo, conditioner, soap and blower dryer are all available. Central Heat & Air that YOU control.  I added a small desk and chair in living room (does not show in pictures yet) in front of windows for all the remote workers!

The downstairs of this home is completely separate with a different entrance, this is where my husband, son and I live. We do ask that you be respectful of noise level and try not to be heavy footed.  

Parking is available in front of house along side of the street and gravel driveway (as long as no one else if parked there).
